response.answer: Andrés Rodríguez-Pose is a leading researcher on the impact of European Cohesion Policy on regional growth, known for his work on EU funds' effect on total factor productivity growth. He has received numerous accolades for his innovative research and contributions to economic geography. Rodríguez-Pose is a member of several high-level expert groups and councils.
